newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 2.53 million barrels in the week ended Oct 25 to 302.35 million barrels from 304.88 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 1.72 million barrels in the week to 238.14 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 3.59 million barrels to 117.89 million from 114.30 million the previous week. PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 2.55 million barrels to 43.25 million barrels.
API said gasoline stocks fell 3.83 million barrels in the week to 186.02 million barrels from 189.84 million barrels. Percent of capacity rose to 94.0 percent from 93.1 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 272,000 barrels to 37.78 million barrels from 37.50 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.28 million barrels from 14.14 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 37.00 million barrels from 37.30 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports rose to 8.59 million barrels per day from 8.13 million, API said.
